name: dsh-link
description: Bidirectional cross-machine remote-control for DeepSeek Harness: each host listens on a token-authenticated HTTP port and exposes a `remote` tool that sends a task to a peer, where the peer's own DSH (headless) executes it. Pairs with UU Remote (or any TCP tunnel) to bridge two LAN-only machines.
